name: PM Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
description: Provides financial assistance to urban poor for construction or enhancement of houses.
benefit: Subsidy up to ₹2.67 lakh on home loan interest

conditions: Must not own a pucca house anywhere in India

name: PM Awas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
description: Housing for All in rural areas — financial assistance to BPL families for house construction.
benefit: ₹1.2 lakh (plains) or ₹1.3 lakh (hills/NE) for house construction

name: Ayushman Bharat – PM Jan Arogya Yojana
description: World's largest health insurance providing free hospital treatment to poor families.
benefit: ₹5 lakh per family per year for hospitalisation — completely free

conditions: SECC listed family OR occupation-based criteria

name: Janani Shishu Suraksha Karyakram (JSSK)
description: Free maternity services for pregnant women and sick newborns at government hospitals.
benefit: Free delivery, C-section, medicines, diagnostics, blood, diet, transport

conditions: Pregnant woman or mother of sick newborn

name: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY)
description: Cash incentive for institutional delivery to reduce maternal and infant mortality.
benefit: ₹1,400 (rural) or ₹1,000 (urban) cash for institutional delivery

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Life insurance cover of Rs 2 lakh for death due to any cause at very low premium.
benefit: Rs 2 lakh life cover at just Rs 436 per year premium

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Accident insurance covering death and disability at just Rs 20 per year.
benefit: Rs 2 lakh for accidental death | Rs 1 lakh for partial disability — only Rs 20/year

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Guaranteed monthly pension for workers in unorganised sector after age 60.
benefit: Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000/month pension after age 60 based on contribution

conditions: Not covered under any statutory social security scheme

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
description: Free LPG connections to women from BPL households to replace dirty cooking fuels.
benefit: Free LPG connection + first refill + hot plate

conditions: No existing LPG connection in household

name: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
description: Scheme to promote girl child education and prevent gender-biased discrimination.
benefit: Education incentives and cash transfers for girl child education up to graduation

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: Maternity benefit to compensate wage loss during pregnancy and nursing.
benefit: Rs 5,000 in 3 instalments for first child

conditions: Registered pregnancy at AWC or health facility

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Small savings scheme for girl child to secure her education and marriage expenses.
benefit: 8.2% interest per year (highest among small savings), tax-free maturity

conditions: Girl child below 10 years of age

name: Swadhar Greh Scheme
description: Shelter and rehabilitation for women in difficult circumstances.
benefit: Free shelter, food, clothing, counselling, legal aid, vocational training

conditions: Women in distress, destitute, or victims of violence or trafficking

name: DAY-NRLM – Self Help Group Loans
description: Interest subvention and credit linkage for women SHGs in rural areas.
benefit: Loans at 7% interest (effective 4% after subvention), up to Rs 6 lakh per SHG

conditions: Member of registered Self Help Group

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Direct income support of Rs 6,000/year to farmer families.
benefit: Rs 6,000 per year in 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 directly to bank

conditions: Must be a farmer with cultivable land

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
description: Short-term credit to farmers for agricultural and allied activities.
benefit: Credit up to Rs 3 lakh at 4% interest rate with timely repayment

conditions: Owner cultivator, tenant farmer, or sharecropper

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Crop insurance providing financial support to farmers for crop failure.
benefit: Full crop loss insurance — premium only 2% for kharif, 1.5% for rabi

conditions: Must have sown notified crop in notified area

name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: Development of fisheries sector — subsidised boats, nets, cold storage for fishermen.
benefit: 40-60% subsidy on fishing equipment, boats, ponds

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGS (MGNREGA)
description: Guarantees 100 days of wage employment per year to rural households.
benefit: 100 days guaranteed work at minimum wage (Rs 220-350/day by state)

conditions: Willing to do unskilled manual work

name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: Credit-linked subsidy for setting up new micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.
benefit: 15-35% subsidy on project cost up to Rs 25 lakh (manufacturing) / Rs 10 lakh (service)

conditions: Minimum 8th pass for projects above Rs 10 lakh

name: PM Mudra Yojana – Shishu Loan
description: Collateral-free loans up to Rs 50,000 for small business startups.
benefit: Loan up to Rs 50,000 without any collateral at low interest

name: PM Mudra Yojana – Kishor Loan
description: Collateral-free loans for growing micro and small businesses.
benefit: Loan Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh without collateral

name: PM SVANidhi – Street Vendor Loan
description: Collateral-free working capital loans for street vendors.
benefit: Rs 10,000 initial loan, then Rs 20,000, then Rs 50,000 on timely repayment

conditions: Street vendor with vending certificate or letter of recommendation from ULB

name: Post Matric Scholarship – SC Students
description: Financial assistance to SC students studying post-matriculation courses.
benefit: Rs 1,200 to Rs 2,250/month maintenance + full tuition fee reimbursement

name: Post Matric Scholarship – ST Students
description: Financial assistance to ST students for post-matriculation studies.
benefit: Rs 1,200 to Rs 2,250/month + tuition fees paid

name: Post Matric Scholarship – OBC Students
description: Scholarship for OBC students pursuing post-matric education.
benefit: Rs 300 to Rs 1,000/month + fees

name: Post Matric Scholarship – Minority Students
description: Scholarship for minority community students from Class 11 to PhD.
benefit: Rs 3,000 to Rs 12,000/year + maintenance allowance

conditions: Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Jain, or Parsi community

name: Central Sector Scholarship – Top Students
description: Merit-based scholarship for top 20 percentile students in Class 12 board exam.
benefit: Rs 12,000/year (undergraduate) | Rs 20,000/year (postgraduate)

conditions: Regular college student not distance learning

name: Pre Matric Scholarship – SC Students
description: Scholarship for SC students studying in Class 9 and 10.
benefit: Rs 150 to Rs 750/month + ad-hoc grant

conditions: Studying in Class 9 or 10 in a government or aided school

name: PM Research Fellowship (PMRF)
description: Fellowship for research at IITs and IISc for bright students.
benefit: Rs 70,000 to Rs 80,000/month fellowship for PhD

conditions: B.Tech or M.Tech or MSc with 8.0+ CGPA

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
description: Monthly pension for BPL senior citizens aged 60 and above.
benefit: Rs 200 to Rs 500/month pension (state may top up significantly)

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension (IGNWPS)
description: Monthly pension for widows from BPL households aged 40 to 79.
benefit: Rs 300/month central contribution + state top-up

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (IGNDPS)
description: Monthly pension for persons with severe or multiple disabilities from BPL households.
benefit: Rs 300/month pension from central government + state top-up

conditions: 80%+ disability certified by government medical board

name: ADIP Scheme – Assistive Devices for Disabled
description: Free assistive devices like wheelchairs, hearing aids, Braille kits to persons with disabilities.
benefit: Free assistive devices worth Rs 10,000 to Rs 20,000

conditions: 40%+ disability certified by govt medical board

name: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Financial assistance to early-stage startups for proof of concept and market entry.
benefit: Up to Rs 20 lakh for PoC | Up to Rs 50 lakh for market entry

conditions: Not received more than Rs 10 lakh in other govt schemes

name: Stand-Up India – SC/ST Entrepreneurs
description: Bank loans for SC/ST and women entrepreneurs to set up greenfield enterprises.
benefit: Loan Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore for greenfield enterprise

name: Stand-Up India – Women Entrepreneurs
description: Bank loans specifically for women to set up new greenfield businesses.
benefit: Loan Rs 10 lakh to Rs 1 crore with repayment up to 7 years

name: PM Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY)
description: Free skill training and certification for youth to improve employment prospects.
benefit: Free skill training + Rs 8,000 reward on certification + placement support

conditions: School or college dropout OR looking to acquire additional skill

name: DDU Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
description: Placement-linked skill training for rural poor youth with guaranteed job placement.
benefit: Free residential training + guaranteed job with min Rs 6,000/month salary

name: Rashtriya Bal Swasthya Karyakram (RBSK)
description: Free health screening and early intervention for children 0 to 18 years.
benefit: Free diagnosis and treatment for 30+ diseases including heart defects and disabilities

conditions: Enrolled in government school or Anganwadi

name: PM Bhartiya Janaushadhi Pariyojana
description: Quality generic medicines at 50-90% cheaper than market price at Jan Aushadhi stores.
benefit: Medicines at 50-90% cheaper price at 9,000+ outlets nationwide — no registration needed

conditions: Any citizen can buy — no registration needed
Just visit nearest Jan Aushadhi store

name: Mahila Shakti Entrepreneurship (MSE)
description: Supports women entrepreneurs with training, credit, and market linkage.
benefit: Subsidised loans, free skill training, market access support

conditions: Woman starting or running a small business

name: Atal Tinkering Labs (ATL) – Students
description: Innovation labs in schools to foster creativity and problem-solving in students.
benefit: Access to Rs 20 lakh worth of equipment — 3D printers, robotics, electronics

conditions: School must have applied for ATL

name: NHM Free Drugs and Diagnostics Service
description: Free essential medicines and diagnostic tests at all public health facilities.
benefit: Free medicines + free lab tests at all government hospitals

conditions: Patient at any government health facility
